The '''Destroyed Village''' was a village on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] that was destroyed by the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac]]. A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] once fought [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kellov]] in the ruins of this village.
